dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings exhibit sharp high-contrast outer boundaries against the dark pelage, with a distinct gradient transition from the bright perimeter to a darker interior core. These are most concentrated along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid-core high-intensity clusters. Most high-contrast features present as annuli; however, localized solid-intensity pixel concentrations are visible on the far-left (anterior) and far-right (posterior) dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent macro-annuli form an irregular, elongated polygon. The three most central centroids create an obtuse triangle with the widest angle oriented toward the ventral-lateral plane.
